goods.description: pd duty here the 30 May last per John Corbin out of the Hopewell of & from Guernsey himself master
came here in a 8 qt in the Richard & Mary Abraham Jones Master from London per coquet dated the 13 ultimo
pd dutys here per J_ Falla the 24 July in a 8 qt out of the Margaret of & from Guernsey Jerem Donnall master

SQL:
SELECT cargos.id,merchant_forename,merchant_surname,merchant_occupation,merchant_abode,miscellanea,marginalia,cargos.contributor,ROUND(SUM(goods.qty*conversions.value*densities.density/1000),1) AS tonnage FROM cargos 
			JOIN goods ON goods.cargo_id = cargos.id 
			LEFT JOIN conversions ON goods.measure = conversions.measure
			LEFT JOIN densities ON goods.commodity LIKE CONCAT('%', densities.commodity, '%')
			WHERE voyage_id='39459' 
			GROUP BY cargos.id
			ORDER BY cargos.seq
